This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. They were distinguished their long, blubbery necks with multiple chin folds, as well as stringy [[hair]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Some time prior to [[22 BBY]],<ref name="EP2Date">{{FilmDate|II}}</ref> at least [[Unidentified fleshy Jedi Master|one member]] of this species was a member of the [[Jedi Order]], their busts displayed within the [[Jedi Archives|Temple Archives]].<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared as a bust in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], written by both [[George Lucas]] and [[Jonathan Hales]], and directed by the former.<ref name="AOTC" />
